source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Power on and boot in BIOS.
2. Change all/random setting to non-default in this BIOS function.
3. Save and reboot.
4. Boot in to BIOS and  check your setting still exist.
5. Press load default,save and reboot.
6. Boot in to BIOS,setting in this function should match the SPEC.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. No error log happen.
2. Normal reboot ,no hang、crash happen.
3. Check your setting still exist.
4. The default setting should matches SPEC."

original_test_intent: Verify that approved Server Mgmt System Event Log controls persist across reboot and return to SPEC defaults while retaining required management-event history and preserving the expected relationship between the BIOS view and BMC SEL storage.
original_method: Archive all relevant log stores, manually change named System Event Log controls in BIOS, save/reboot and verify persistence, then Load Default, save/reboot and compare with SPEC while checking event visibility, host health and management access.
manual_activity: An engineer must operate and visually inspect the BIOS Server Mgmt log controls, distinguish stored policy from clear-now actions, approve any evidence-destructive step and execute both reboot phases. Automated SEL retrieval is not the firmware acceptance itself.
required_inputs: BIOS/BMC identity and authoritative System Event Log ownership
Exact controls, clear/filter/fullness effects and reset dependencies
Approved baseline, non-default and SPEC-default values
Expected BIOS-view/BMC-SEL correlation and clock basis
Archived logs, console/OOB recovery and controlled event
safety_requirements: Export and hash or otherwise preserve each affected log store before any clearing or policy change.
Do not execute all/random or invoke clear-now, erase-on-boot or filtering actions without explicit scope and evidence-loss approval.
Do not assume the BIOS page and BMC SEL are separate or identical; establish ownership first.
Stop on unexpected log loss, event suppression, BMC reachability loss, boot failure or time-order corruption.
agent_execution_scope: Collect read-only BMC SEL, BIOS-exported log if supported, OS logs, identity, clock and management-health evidence.
Correlate event records across stores using source, sensor/event type and timestamp.
Do not drive BIOS, clear logs, change policy or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve store ownership, control semantics, values/defaults, archive and recovery.
Perform/capture persistence and default-restoration actions plus the approved benign event.
Assess event retention/correlation and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly avoids agent BIOS operation. No source command exists; an IPMI/Redfish SEL read may corroborate behavior only after store ownership is established.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Keep the firmware workflow and use platform-approved read-only SEL retrieval with exact protocol/tool version and store attribution. Never issue a clear command as a substitute.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source lifecycle, null script and 5/20-minute fields are retained; its pre-test clear-logs instruction is not authorization to destroy the log under test.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Identify the authoritative log store and any BIOS presentation layer, preserve full pre-change records and clocks, exercise only approved policy fields, inject a benign traceable event, and verify record retention/correlation across persistence/defaults.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact BIOS/BMC implementation and its System Event Log ownership model.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS, BMC, SEL protocol/client, OS and clock-source versions/settings.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform Server Mgmt System Event Log and BMC SEL documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative-store identity, clock alignment and event correlation instead of generic log checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; strengthens the setting lifecycle with proof of actual management-event behavior.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Store map, control effects, event model, defaults and archive method.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A BIOS viewer may cache, filter or proxy BMC events; matching counts alone may be insufficient.

project_override_considerations: A project may test only non-destructive enable/filter/fullness settings and exclude clearing. The result must list excluded actions and the authoritative store; it cannot claim complete SEL lifecycle coverage.
expected_evidence: Platform/store ownership, field/action matrix, approval and recovery
Full attributed pre-change BIOS/BMC/OS archives and clock alignment
Non-default captures, persistence and controlled-event correlation
Load Default, SPEC comparison and retained/expected event behavior
Final policy, management/host health, archives and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source can coherently apply to actual log policy fields. The pre-test instruction to clear logs must be constrained so it does not erase the test target, but no explicit opposite PASS condition exists.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The policy persistence/default intent is identifiable. Store ownership, fields and archive method are readiness inputs that must gate execution but do not permanently block the case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agrees on manual execution and adds authoritative-store and evidence-retention analysis.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its archive and separate-log safeguards but corrects the top-level classification to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats the source's clear-logs language conservatively and requires correlation between firmware presentation and the management event store.

review_improvement: Prevents forensic loss and false equivalence between BIOS event presentation and BMC SEL while adding a traceable event-correlation test.
independent_technical_reasoning: Human firmware operation and on-screen verification are central. Automated SEL reads can corroborate records but cannot navigate or accept the BIOS settings, so MANUAL ONLY is appropriate.
no_automatic_retry: Do not repeat policy changes, event generation, clearing or reboot after unexpected log/management behavior; preserve the first trace and obtain engineer disposition.
